sentences.text: The present application under Section 482 read with Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. seeks interim bail in case FIR No. 523/2022 under Sections 304B/406/498A/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Sabzi Mandi for processing the registration of birth certificate of his minor son as well as for Baal Aadhar Card for getting admission in pre-school.

Sister of accused stated that she inquired about the admission of Vivan in play school i.e Creative Minds, Kalyan Vihar, Delhi and it was told to her from schools that birth certificate of child is mandatory for admission in school.
3. The School Creative Minds, Kalyan Vihar, Delhi was also visited for enquiry but the school was found closed due to vacations.
The Owner/Manager of the school namely Mr. Sandeep was contacted telephonically who informed that birth Certificate of child and ID proof of either parent is required for admission in school.

4. In view of above facts, during enquiry it has been verified that accused has a son of age about 2.5 years who is to be admitted in school as per application of accused and statements of family members of accused found at the given address.
As per the enquiry regarding requisite documents for admission it has come up that birth certificate is mandatory for admission of child.
However birth certificate can be applied with ID proof of either parent and birth proof of child."

3. In view of the above, the applicant is directed to be released on interim bail till the next date of hearing, i.e., 18.07.2024, on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety of like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court/Link Court, further subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not leave India without prior permission of the learned Trial Court.
ii. The applicant shall intimate the learned Trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in residential address.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the learned Trial Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/06/2024 at 21:17:24 iv.
The applicant is directed to give his mobile number to the Investigating Officer and keep it operational at all times.
v. The applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, tamper with evidence or try to influence the witness in any manner.

4. List on 18.07.2024 before Roster Bench.
5.
Copy of the order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent for necessary information and compliance.
